answer: An AI-agent economy can curb Sybil attacks using hardware enclave attestation. Each agent binds its identity to a physical TPM, channeling signed runtime measurements across a data river. Even amid a gale of automated registrations, a raven verifier detects spoofed nodes by validating silicon endorsements. This forces an attacker to expend real capital on dedicated microchips per identity. However, reliance on proprietary chipmakers introduces centralized supply-chain trust.
